steps.description: Given a table of states (one or several overlays, up to four, hidden ones, the hide flag, a broken file, the service stopped, hotkeys, an item showing a maximum, a gesture 10 s ago, saved looks, an update ready, the menu opened on a pill of several or on the overlay's only pill, an overlay on the desktop, locked, which then offers no Separate, items with a graph of their own or none judged), when thermi's menu and the overlay's menu are built, then each row's entries, their groups, their order, their checks and their bold default are the table's, and nothing offered changes nothing.

Given the overlay, when the author opens the window from its menu, thermi's menu, a double-click on a value and on the edge, `thermi settings` and Start, with the window closed and then behind others, then one window opens on the right item or overlay, or comes to the front focused.

Given a real overlay host and window beacon on a test desktop, and a table of messages (the history, a double-click on a value, a click to select, edited, a gesture, a second thermi), when each is sent, then the other side acts on it within 500 ms: the window opens on the item, holds the ten minutes with their gaps, selects, marks, adds the gesture to its history, or comes to the front.

Given --trace and the overlay's CPU time and memory, when the window opens cold and warm, stays idle, a knob is dragged for a minute, the window closes, and an hour of use passes, then the first frame is under 2 s and 1 s, every paint lands within 300 ms of its input at most 10 times a second, the budgets hold, no window or WebView2 process is left, and memory stays within 5 MB.

Given the page and a fake bridge in a table of states (no overlay, the service stopped, stale data, a broken file, a CPU sensor needing the driver, the driver refused and installed), when the page shows each and its action is taken, then the page offers the row's fix, takes no edit while the file is broken, and the state moves on as the fake answers.

Given a real PC, when the author opens the window without the overlay, stops and starts the service, installs the driver refusing and then accepting Windows' prompt, edits the file by hand, breaks it and restores it, then the window follows each and recovers on its own.

Given a table of edits (a threshold, a switch, a rename, a move, three changes of one box within a second and one after), when they are undone and redone, then each step is named from what it changed and back, and the changes within a second are one step.

Given the page with the fake bridge, when an edit is undone and redone by keys, also with a slider focused, and by the title row's buttons, then the settings go back and forth, the buttons stay reachable when unavailable, the pane shows what changed, and the toast that says so moves nothing and goes after 6 s.

Given an item added, one deleted and one moved by the window, and the added one then edited by hand, when all three are undone, then the deleted item is back in place, the move is reverted, and the hand-edited item stays with a skipped step.

Given the page with two overlays, when the list is used by keys alone (arrows, Home, End, folding, type-ahead, F2, Alt+arrows, Delete, the row menus, Ctrl+N, Ctrl+F, Ctrl+, and F1), and then an item is dragged out to its own pill, then the selection, the pane and the settings follow, Delete selects the next row, the arrows never leave the list, and the rows keep their names while values refresh.

Given the page with the fake bridge, when the catalog opens from each overlay, is searched, and adds with Enter and with Ctrl+Enter, and Esc is pressed twice, then the item lands on the overlay picked, the catalog closes or stays as asked, and the new item is selected and in view.

Given the admin recording and a table of searches (words in any order, a name, a device, a type, each synonym, chips, and a word that matches nothing), when the catalog is filtered, then each row lists exactly its sensors, and the last offers one word.
Given readings over two minutes on a fake clock, when a sparkline is read, then it holds the last minute and nothing older.

Given the recording without admin rights, when the catalog is built, then the CPU temperature, power and clocks reading zero say the driver may be missing, and the clocks with no value say they read nothing.

Given every sensor of the admin recording, when each is added as an item, then each shows in the unit of its type, joins the pill of its device's kind after its last item or goes at the end, and is named like the defaults, with its sensor's name when that name is taken and a number when the same sensor is added again.

Given the page with the fake bridge and a table of the item page's rows (Sensor, Shows, Smoothing, Label, Graph, Notify me, Separate pill, Tray icon and each of More options), when each row is changed by keys, Shows and Smoothing without opening More options, then the settings hold the row's change, a row that cannot apply is locked with its reason, as only on alert for the RAM in use warned by nothing, a pill's first item offers no Separate pill, the next item's page opens at its top with More options closed, a page scrolled to its More options stays where it was through dropdown picks by pointer and keys (what it shows back to the value now among them), a switch, an undo, a redo and new readings, the control looked at staying where it shows through Warn by turned off and its undo, which take the Graph row above it away and back, and through a switch at the pane's foot and its undo, under the news that floats there, and Warn by offers the item's own readings alone: a temperature only itself, so no row, the CPU fan its speed and its duty, power nothing, which then offers no Graph and no only on alert.

Given a series derived from the recorded one, with the board's fan answering the load three times as strongly, and one where it answers at once, when the finder replays them, then it starts the load only after 3 s of readings, runs at least 8 s, and stops 3 s after a fan meets the rule or at 8 s if that is later.

Given the CPU fan item and a fake finder, when "Find it" is asked and turned down, then runs, is cancelled, runs again and its pick is used, then nothing loads until "Load the CPU", the row shows the run and its result in place, Cancel stops it, and using the pick changes the item's sensor.

Given Task Manager and a board that drives the CPU fan, when the finder runs and is cancelled, then every core is loaded at below-normal priority, the load ends within a second of Cancel, and a full run picks the CPU fan.

Given a table of series (derived ones where the board's fan answers, the recorded one where software drives it, two fans alike, a load under 80 %, no driver, no fan outside the GPUs), when the finder replays each, then it picks the answering fan, keeping what the item warns by as one undo step, or picks nothing with the row's reason.

Given a table of readings (an AMD and an Intel CPU temperature, a GPU and a board temperature, a load, a duty, a fan speed, power, clock and memory), when each is what an item warns by, then the row's acceptance, default lines, unit, step, push between lines, chart range and color bands are the table's, and an item of that sensor may warn only by the table's readings of itself: its own where thresholds judge its type, a fan also its own duty and a duty its own fan, the CPU fan's metric its duty's, and a combined item only its own; the lowest line held for more than half of the ten minutes fires most of the time, and for half of them does not.

Given an item's page, when a knob is dragged, clicked, typed into, moved by every key, pushed past the other, and deleted, and then the readings stop, then the lines follow, the box keeps or goes back, the focus lands on the next control, and the chart's place says why while its lines and knobs stay.

Given the page with two monitors and a table of Placement's controls (each spot of the map, the taskbar's one included, a monitor that is gone, vertical, When to show, lock, click-through and OLED care), when each is chosen by keys, then the settings hold the row's change.
Given monitors at 100 % and 150 %, when the overlay snaps to each corner, then it sits inside the work area, the top corners 64 px below its top times the scale.

Given an overlay beside the notification area, one dropped on the taskbar and one in a corner, when its width grows, then the edge each keeps stays where it was, and on a taller taskbar it stays in its middle.
Given a snapped overlay, when it is moved further than the drag distance and dropped, then the snap is gone and the dropped position is saved.
Given the overlay snapped to the second monitor, when the PC restarts, and when that monitor moves to another port, then the snap still finds it.

Given the page with two overlays and a table of Appearance's controls (Look tiles, Size, Theme and Use on all overlays, Layout and direction, Graph, opacity, Text and shape with Show units and Show labels, Colors and colorblind-safe, Save as my look and each look's menu, Export), when each is changed by keys, then the settings hold the row's change; Default takes the whole look back, its tile checked, no tile is checked once the look changed, and a look saved is the one checked, the page not moving.
Given every edit that would leave the settings invalid, when it is applied, then the settings are unchanged and the reason is returned.
Given two writers that read the file at the same moment, when both write, then the file holds both changes.
Given a file emptied and then written again, and one removed and then put back, as editors save, when each is read meanwhile, then the overlay never shows the defaults and the file is not recreated.
Given a broken file, when the settings are restored, then the broken file is kept under a dated name and the last good settings are written.
Given the window's own write, when its watcher event arrives, then it is not taken as an outside change.

Given the version 1 file of spec 001 with sources, when it is read, then it becomes the current version with each source applied to its items and what they warn by, and shows the same overlay, an item without a meter drawing nothing, a wrong-type source still showing as missing, lines still at 0.1's defaults taking this version's calm ones and lines the user moved kept.
Given a file with items without ids and one with a repeated id, when it is read twice, then both reads give the same unique ids, the first holder keeps each repeated id, and a write stores them.

Given the page with the fake bridge, when the design prototype's 102 steps of keys and clicks run, then after each the focus is on a control in view, never the page, dialogs keep it inside, and menus give it back.

Given every page, dialog, menu, bar and toast, in light, dark and forced colors, and with reduced motion, when axe checks each and the animations are read, then axe finds no violation and nothing animates.

Given Narrator, light, dark, another accent, high contrast and animation effects off, when the author moves through the window and resizes, maximizes, snaps and activates it over the overlays, then everything is read with its name, role and value, looks right in each, nothing animates, it behaves like any window, and the edited overlay stays above it unless it would cover the caption buttons.

Given the page with the fake bridge, when the language, the unit, the window's theme and Start with Windows change, a hotkey is recorded, refused, cleared and cancelled, and Reset is asked and cancelled, then the settings hold each change, Start with Windows is outside undo, thermi's hotkeys rest while one records, and Cancel is the destroying dialog's default.
Given Start with Windows turned off, when thermi is reinstalled and the author signs out and in, then the overlay does not start, and Ctrl+Z never touched the switch.

Given two overlays with every field changed, when the settings are reset and the reset undone after a hand edit, then one default overlay is left, shown always, the language, hotkeys, unit and window theme stay, and undo brings back every field still at its default while the hand edit stays.

Given the default settings, when the look is read and one size then changes, then it is Standard text on pills that match the taskbar with green meters at normal and the darker level colors on light pills, each at 3:1 against its pill and a graph's unlit track, and then it becomes the overlay's own, keeping the rest; and a look's tile samples it as three pills, CPU temperature and load, GPU load and RAM used, each lit, in the look's own pills.

Given light and dark wallpapers and taskbars, when the author looks at the overlay with each theme, font, effect and 0 % background, at each level, the first critical, a stopped service and its tooltips, then every value reads well, the levels read without color, the glow comes once, and the tooltips say what to do.

Given Auto text on dark and light pills, a custom gray label, and a white value on light pills, when the overlay is laid out, then Auto gives today's colors and the dark ones, the gray is kept, and the white is drawn in its Auto color and flagged.

Given settings with items, placement, a layout, a direction, language and a look, when the look is read from them, then it holds the theme, the background opacity, the colors, and the text and shape, and no layout, direction, position or size.

Given a look file and the same look as pasted text, when each is imported and then undone, then the overlay shows it at once and undo brings back the look before; saved with "Save as my look", it is listed, and under a taken name it asks for another.

Given a broken style file, one with thermiStyle 2, one with a size of 30, one with a background opacity of 5, one with an overlay opacity of 0.1, and one with the color red, when they are imported, then each is refused with its reason naming the field, and nothing changes.

Given a full-screen video and a borderless game, the four hotkeys and thermi's icon, when the author hides and shows by each way, presses each hotkey, and opens both menus by mouse and keyboard, then the overlays follow, a hotkey another app holds is refused, and the menus are Windows' own and follow the theme.

Given four hotkeys written within a second and an overlay that has registered only the first, when the window asks for the hotkey status, then it trusts no answer until the hash matches the four it shows; and with no overlay running, it says the hotkeys need it.

Given one overlay hidden on its own, when "Hide overlays" is set, the file read again, a click on thermi's icon comes, the window opens on the hidden overlay, and thermi starts again, then the flag is never in the file, the click clears only the flag, a hidden overlay stays off the desktop whatever the window edits, and a new start shows the overlays by their visibility.
Given Windows in Spanish, and then `thermi settings --pseudo`, when the author goes through both menus, every page and the catalog, then every text thermi writes is Spanish, and long texts fit.
Given English as the language on a Windows set to Spanish regional format, when values are formatted, then they read 1.087 RPM and 27,2 GB.
Given the English texts and every translation, when their keys are compared, then each translation has every key and no others.

Given a matrix of window sizes, text at 100 % and 200 %, and English and the long pseudo-language, when every page, dialog and menu shows in each, then nothing is cut, overlaps or scrolls sideways, and the list folds where the matrix says.

Given a table of states (levels, a missing driver, a sensor reading nothing, the service stopped or stale, overlays hidden, click-through, high contrast, before and after the window's first opening), when the overlay, its tooltips, thermi's tooltip and thermi's mark are decided, then each row gives its parts, its mark's state and its one pill while sensors are stopped, and thermi's tooltip stays within 127 characters.

Given an overlay with a clock among the sensors' items and the service stopped, so the feed holds nothing but what Windows itself says, when the overlay and the tray icons are decided, then the "Sensors stopped" pill stands in for the sensors' items only, the clock shows its time beside it and in its tray icon, and thermi's mark still says the sensors stopped.

Given thermi's icon and three item icons at 100 %, 150 % and 200 % on a dark and a light taskbar, when the PC restarts, Explorer restarts and the items change level, then the icons read at a glance, keep their pins, come back, and the mark wakes and alarms.

Given 62 °C, 12.6 %, 1,087 RPM, 12,345 RPM, 27.3 GB, 128.4 GB and a missing value, when each becomes a tray icon's text, then it reads 62, 13, 1087, 12k, 27.3, 128 and –, and 27,3 with Spanish regional format.
Given values that do not change, when the icons refresh for ten seconds, then none is redrawn; when one value changes, only its icon is.

Given 62 °C with thresholds 70 and 85, when the unit is °F, then it reads 144 °F, the thresholds show 158 and 185, the file keeps 70 and 85, and the widest temperature is 212 °F; a threshold set to 150 °F is kept as 65.6.

Given units hidden, when the default items, thermi's tooltip and an item icon's tooltip are made, then values show without units and labels stay, thermi's tooltip follows the overlay, and the item icon's tooltip keeps its unit; and given labels hidden, the pills keep their items and show no label.

Given a table of events (a first start, the window opened, overlays hidden by the flag, one overlay hidden on its own, hiding from the window, click-through on for one and for all, clicks coming back), when the notices are decided, then each shows once in its form, with its buttons, none comes from the window, and each goes when what it is about ends.

Given a first start, overlays hidden from thermi's menu, click-through turned on, and an item critical with Notify me, when each notice shows, then it comes from thermi's icon with its buttons, its actions work, and clicks pass through the overlay until click-through is off.

Given 100 warm-up rounds, each painting the overlay, refreshing three tray icons, reloading the settings, and seeing the window's mutex appear and vanish with a show, when 10,000 more run, then GDI and USER handles are exactly where they were after the warm-up, and the managed heap after a full collection is within 1 MB.

Given the CCD1 and CCD2 temperatures and the 16 core powers of the admin recording, when items combine the temperatures as highest and average with an offset of -5, and the powers as a sum, then they read the highest and the average less 5 in °C, and the total power; a sum of temperatures is refused, an offset of -5 °C shows as -9 °F, offsets past their type's range are refused, and with every sensor missing an item shows as missing.
Given an item showing its maximum, and values 60, 75 and 70 on a fake clock, when they arrive and then min and max are reset, then it shows 75, and then the next value.

Given a table of values (normal, warning and critical on dark and light pills and under high contrast, percentages under 0 and over 100, bars and a line), when the overlay is laid out, then each value carries its row's mark, a value at warning whose bars or line show it none, percentages are held between 0 and 100, and an item thresholds judge holds its line or else its lit bars, and the power neither.

Given the GPU item set to show only on alert, at 40 % and then at 70 %, when the overlay is laid out snapped to the right, then the GPU pill is gone and the right edge stays, and then it is back at its warning level; with the window open it shows at 40 % too, a power item, which thresholds cannot judge, cannot be set to alert-only, and the RAM in use loses alert-only, and its graph, once it warns by nothing.
Given two overlays in the file, when it is read, then each has its own items, placement and style, ids are unique across both, and the version 1 file becomes one overlay.

Given a table of edits (new, duplicate, merge, delete, hide, move an item to another or a new overlay, a pill held 499 and 500 ms by the injected clock and dragged off, a drop that merges, a drop on the taskbar, a corner resize, Alt+arrows on a free overlay and one on the taskbar), when each is applied and undone, then the overlays are the row's, with no name stored and read by where they sit, so a move renames them, at most 4, an emptied one removed, and each is one undo step.

Given the page with three overlays, when one is made, duplicated, merged, hidden, shown and deleted from the list and the overlay page, then the settings follow, the new one takes the focus, and after a delete or merge the focus is on the next or the target row.

Given four overlays on two monitors and a crowded taskbar, when the author clicks values with the window open, holds pills until they lift and drags them off, onto another overlay and onto the desktop, drags one before the hold, presses Esc during a drag, merges and resizes overlays, opens and closes apps, and undoes a gesture from the overlay's menu, then the window follows, the marks and fades show, a lifted pill joins where it is let go or becomes an overlay that snaps, a drag before the hold moves the whole overlay, Esc puts everything back, a hidden overlay shows only in the window, and no overlay on the taskbar moves as apps open and close.

Given an item with Notify me on a fake clock and a table of episodes (critical for 9 s, for 10 s, staying, cooling and coming back, and during a full-screen app), when the notices are decided, then one comes per episode after 10 s, and one held through full screen comes on leaving it, with its peak and length.

Given a table of work areas, monitor setups and free overlays, when the window's first size and place, its minimum, its remembered size, the list's width and fold, and the pane's columns are decided, then each is the row's.

Given a table of combinations (with Win, Alt with a letter, Ctrl with each common letter, Alt+F4, Ctrl+Alt+Delete, the window's shortcuts, an AltGr character on a Spanish layout, another hotkey's, Shift alone, F13, Ctrl+Alt+T), when each is judged, then it is refused with its row's reason or taken.

Given two overlays dropped on the taskbar, the second where the first ends, when they are placed, then each sits at its own offset on the same line, touching, with no room kept between them or beside any app button.
Given a 0 % background, when the overlay is laid out, then every pixel of every pill has an alpha of at least 1, and with click-through off the overlay catches a click between two values.

Given new rows of throughputs (0, 999 and 1,000 B/s, 812 KB/s, 12.4 MB/s, 1.05 GB/s), in English and Spanish regional formats, with units shown and hidden, and as a tray icon's text, when each is formatted, then it reads in the row's unit with three significant digits, keeps its scale letter without units, and fits the tray icon's 4 characters.

Given new rows from an admin recording with two adapters and two drives, when the catalog is built and the five network and disk metrics are picked, then adapters sit under Network and drives under Disk, each metric follows the row's adapter or drive, a drive's temperature is a temperature, and an item that names an adapter keeps it.

Given new rows for a throughput and a disk activity meter, when each is chosen, then neither starts with lines, and the throughput's chart runs from 0 to its highest reading plus 15 %, rounded up to a 1-2-5 step.

Given new rows for the recording's download, upload, read and write rates, when each is added as an item, then download and upload share one NET pill, each value with its direction arrow, read and write take their own labels, and the default overlay is unchanged.

Given the page with the fake bridge holding two adapters and two drives, when the catalog opens, then it offers a Network group and a Disk group by role, and the Throughput chip filters to their rates.

Given a PC with two drives and two adapters and the service running as installed, when the author downloads a large file and copies one between drives, then the NET pill and the disk items follow the busy adapter and drive, the catalog lists both groups, and the service stays under 80 MB of private memory at rest.

Given new rows of a battery's charge, a rate while charging and while discharging, a time remaining, and no time while plugged in, in English and Spanish regional formats, when each is formatted, then the charge is a percentage, the rate carries its sign in watts, the time reads in hours and minutes, and no time is missing.
steps.note: awaits a real recording (T105, T108): its rows are made up

steps.description: Given new rows from a laptop's recording with a battery and virtual adapters, and from the existing desktop recordings, when the catalog is built and the metrics are picked, then the battery sits under Battery on the laptop and no Battery group exists on the desktops, and Auto's adapter is never a loopback, tunnel or non-hardware one while a physical one moves data.
steps.note: awaits a real recording (T105, T108): its rows are made up

steps.description: Given new rows on the injected clock with a gap in the snapshots longer than the stale limit, before and after the first snapshot newer than the wake, when the overlay is decided, then no value from before the gap shows as live, its history leaves the gap out of Min, Avg, Max and the chart, and the first fresh snapshot brings the values back.
steps.note: awaits a real recording (T105, T108): its rows are made up

steps.description: Given a snapped overlay and a wake from sleep with a different set of monitors, when the layout changes, then the overlay goes back to its snap, or to the same spot on the primary monitor when its own is gone.
steps.note: awaits a real recording (T105, T108): its rows are made up

steps.description: Given the page with a fake bridge for a laptop and one for a desktop, when the catalog opens, then the laptop's offers a Battery group by role and the desktop's offers none.
steps.note: awaits a real recording (T105, T108): its rows are made up

steps.description: Given a laptop with the service running as installed and an external monitor, when the author adds the battery's items, unplugs it, puts it to sleep, unplugs the monitor and wakes it, then the battery reads its charge, rate and time, no stale value shows as live after waking, readings and speeds come back within 5 s without a click, and the overlays go back to their places.

Given a PC with WSL or Hyper-V and a VPN on, when the author downloads a large file, then Auto follows the physical adapter; and with Task Manager open beside the overlay, at rest and during "thermi cpu-load 30", CPU load stays within 3 points of Task Manager's CPU utilization on Windows 11.

Given a Windows 10 22H2 64-bit virtual machine with thermi installed, when the author opens the window in light, dark and high contrast and uses the overlay on the taskbar and the desktop, then the window is readable on an opaque background with square corners, nothing is missing or transparent, and the overlay sits on the taskbar, drags, hides and shows as on Windows 11.

Given the recorded desktop, whose Gigabyte board's ITE IT8689E names its inputs by number, and a made-up board with a Nuvoton chip, when the catalog is built, then the ITE's temperatures 1 to 5 and fans and duties 1 to 3 show their probable names, each marked likely with the library's name, its other inputs and the Nuvoton's keep the library's name with the chip and the input, no other sensor gets either, and the search finds the CPU's board sensor by its probable name.

Given the recorded desktop with and without administrator rights, when the catalog is built before and after a stopped fan turns, then it hides the sensors that read nothing, the board's fans at 0 RPM that never turned, the GPUs' D3D loads and each core's effective clock, keeps the CPU sensors that need the driver and the GPU's fan at 0 RPM, at rest while the GPU is cool, counts what each search hides, and shows a fan once it has turned; a drive's fixed limits and wear counters are not listed at all.

Given the recorded desktop and an overlay with two items of one board sensor, one of them renamed by hand, and a metric item that picks it, when the sensor is renamed, renamed too long, renamed empty, undone and redone, a new item of it is added and the overlay is reset, then the settings hold its name by id, the item thermi named takes it while the others keep theirs, the catalog and its search use it, a name over 40 characters is refused, an empty one gives back the library's, each rename is one step, the new item is named by it, and the reset keeps it.

Given the page with the fake bridge over the recorded desktop, when a search lists only what the catalog hides and "Show all" is pressed, and a board input found by its probable name is renamed with F2, once left with Esc and once kept with Enter, then added, then Show all lists the hidden sensors, the row shows the probable name, Esc changes nothing and gives the row back the focus, the name typed reaches the settings, and the new item is named by it.

Given an overlay on the taskbar at an offset, and one without, when the notification area grows, the taskbar moves to the top, the screen is narrower or at another scale, the taskbar hides or stands on a side, or its notification area is not found, then the first keeps its offset, held whole on the taskbar, and floats just above the work area's bottom at it, clear of a hiding taskbar's band, where it cannot sit on the taskbar; the second follows the notification area, or keeps the reserve from the end.

Given the page with a fake bridge whose main monitor's taskbar is on a side, and then hides, when the overlay snapped to its taskbar is selected, then the Position row says why it floats; and "Fade near the pointer", switched by keys, lands in the settings.

Given Windows 10 with the taskbar at the left, the right, the top and hiding, and Windows 11 with StartAllBack's taskbar at the top and TranslucentTB's clear one, when the author drops the overlay along each taskbar, then it sits on each taskbar that lies across its monitor where it was dropped and floats clear of the others, the window saying why; moving the taskbar to another edge, or setting it to hide, restarting Explorer, or changing the resolution or scale, with the overlay running, moves the overlay with it within a second, at the same offset from the taskbar's start; and an overlay dropped half off the screen shows whole inside the work area.

Given the recorded desktop without administrator rights, with Windows' uptime, address and clock added as the overlay adds them, when the catalog is built and the three are added as items, then the catalog lists them under PC, and the overlay shows UP, IP and TIME with the uptime, the address and the time with its seconds in the regional format, none with a level; and with no address, Local IP shows as missing.

Given a table of readings, when each is formatted, then a time shows with its seconds in the regional format, an address as its four numbers, and a throughput in bits takes bps, Kbps, Mbps or Gbps with three significant digits, its letter without units and in a tray icon.

Given the page with the fake bridge, when a network speed's item opens More options and its bits switch is pressed by keys, then the switch lands in the settings, and an item of another type offers none.
Given a table of states, when thermi's menu and an overlay's menu are built, then "Open Task Manager" follows "Settings…" in thermi's, and "Copy as image" in the overlay's.

Given thermi installed, when the author opens Task Manager from both menus, points at the CPU and GPU values, runs `thermi cpu-load 30` with the CPU's lines lowered until it is critical, copies the overlay as an image into Paint, turns on Fade near the pointer and moves the pointer towards the overlay and away, and removes the driver, then Task Manager opens, the tooltips name the models, the busiest process and any throttling, the picture is the overlay, the overlay fades and comes back while it still takes a double-click, and the CPU pill says Driver, whose double-click opens the window with the driver's bar; and the overlay stays within R154's budget with Fade on.

Given the recorded desktop with and without administrator rights, a busiest process and a table of items, when the overlay's scene and its tooltips are made, then a CPU's or GPU's value names its model, a critical one also its busiest process, a value of another device neither, and without the driver the CPU's temperature and power show Driver with the driver's tooltip, while the GPU's load still shows its value.

Given the recorded desktop with its CPU clock and temperature set by a table, and a base clock or none, when the overlay's scene is made, then the CPU's temperature and clock values are marked throttling, with the tooltip saying so, only while the clock is under the base clock and the temperature at its warning or above.

Given the overlay running on the recorded desktop, with the clipboard faked, when "Copy as image" is chosen from its menu, then the clipboard holds one PNG the size of the overlay as it shows, and the real clipboard is never touched.

Given a table of overlays, pointers and states, when the overlay's opacity is decided, then it is whole beyond 96 px at its scale, 25 % on the overlay and in between as the pointer nears, and whole while off, while the window is open, while it is dragged and under click-through.

Given a table of free overlays dropped on the desktop, half off the screen, over the taskbar or across two monitors, when each is placed, then it shows whole inside the work area of the monitor it lies most on.
Given the monitors as Windows listed them before the taskbar moved to another edge or began to hide, when the overlay reads them for a paint, then each comes with the work area Windows gives now.

Given the installed build and its window open on its first item for 30 s, when scripts/measure.ps1 -Window measures it for 60 s, then thermi.exe's window and its renderer use under 1 % of one core together, and minimized, the renderer nothing.
Given the window hidden, when a second's readings come, then it draws none of them, and once it shows again it draws the latest.
Given the default overlay painted, when the open window marks CPU load as selected, then its mark is a bar lying under the value's middle, wider than tall.

Given a taskbar with its notification area and an overlay 550 px wide, when it is dropped anywhere along the taskbar, over the app buttons, over the notification area and past its end, 96 and 97 px along it from its marks, with its edge 96 and 97 px from the taskbar, from a corner's mark, or between a top corner's mark and the top, and with Alt held on the taskbar, near a corner and off both, then on the taskbar it stays where it was let go along it, centered across it and whole on it, unless a mark is within 96 px, which it goes to; near a corner it goes to the corner's mark; and with Alt held it stays where it was let go, on the taskbar or free.

Given the recorded desktop and items reading a GPU's load, the CPU's load, a sensor the dropdown leaves out but the item names, the RAM in use, an adapter's download and a sensor no longer read, when each item's Sensor dropdown is built, then it lists its own device's sensors of its type first and the other devices' only behind "Show all", of data only the item's own kind of device's, and an item whose sensor is not read lists every device's at once.

Given the recorded desktop, with a Ryzen's graphics chip and a GeForce card, when the chip's frequency, the card's fan duty and the chip's load are added in turn, then the card's fan duty joins the GPU pill and the chip's two sensors an iGPU pill at the end.

Given the window open on an overlay and a value, when it is minimized and restored, then it tells the overlay it edits none, so no value is marked nor overlay faded, and then the overlay and value again.

Given the recorded desktop's catalog and a table of searches (two words in either order, an accent and capitals, the name of the metric a sensor feeds, a long word with one letter wrong, a short one), when each is typed, then the first rows are the table's, each with what matched marked in its name, its second line or the metric it feeds, and the short typo finds nothing.

Given the window in dark and in light, when the author types in the catalog's search and in a Sensor dropdown's filter, then each row marks what matched on a faint accent, readable in both themes and under high contrast; the dropdown's status line says the count, a row says when nothing matches, and Enter takes the first.

Given a version 2 file with an item without a meter, a load metered by itself and no lines and a load given a warning, when it is read, then it becomes version 6, the first drawing nothing, the second its line and the third its bars, as they did; and the default overlay's CPU and GPU loads draw their lines.

Given two overlays, when one is dragged over the other, then it shows whole, the other ringed with a bar where it would join, and no snap mark lights; a pill held still lifts leaving an empty slot where it was; after a drop no tooltip shows until the pointer leaves or 1.5 s pass; the Position map's taskbar spot sits under the overlay's middle; Esc mid-drag with the mouse still reaches no other app; and on a load's item page, Graph is a row after Label, and None keeps the load drawing nothing after a restart.

Given an overlay dragged on the desktop near a corner's mark, with its marks showing, when it is let go, let go with Alt held, cancelled with Esc down as the mouse moves, or loses the mouse to another window, then it snaps to that corner, stays free where it was let go, or goes back to its snap with the file unchanged, and the desktop shows the overlay alone. Esc counts also with the mouse still, as the overlay's hotkey while pressed.
Given the overlay process, when Exit thermi is chosen, or Windows asks its host window or an overlay to close, then its window goes and its message loop ends.

Given version 4 files with an overlay at the taskbar's right, left and center, and one in a corner, when each is read, then it becomes the current version with the taskbar's one place: beside the notification area for the right and the center, 8 px from the start for the left, and the corner as it was.

Given a pill held until it lifts, and an overlay of one pill moved whole, when the pill is dropped on an overlay of one pill in front of that pill and past it, back on its own overlay in front of its first pill and on its own place, and the overlay is dropped on another in front of one of its pills, then the pill joins that overlay before it and after it, moves to the front of its own and stays where it was on its own place, and the overlay's pill joins the other before the pill it was dropped in front of.

Given the overlay on a desktop of its own, when a pill is held still until it lifts and dropped in front of its own overlay's first pill, a press leaves the drag distance and comes back before holding, an overlay of one pill is dragged onto another, also with Alt held, a lifted pill is dropped on the overlay of one pill and another thrown far onto the desktop, and the overlay of many is dragged over the one of one pill with the cursor beside it, then the pill moves to the front of its overlay, the overlay moves whole, the dragged overlay shows whole and joins the other before the pill it is let go on, and with Alt held stays apart, the lifted pill joins the overlay of one pill, the thrown one becomes an overlay of its own, and the overlay of many joins the one of one pill.

Given the owner's taskbar after a pill was dragged off, the CPU overlay beside the notification area, the one-pill CPU power overlay to its left, a hidden third one and a fourth between them, when an overlay or a lifted pill is dragged with the cursor on another, with the cursor just above it, with half or just less of itself over it, beside it touching, the big overlay over the small one with the cursor beside it, a pill over two at once, or with Alt held, then it is on that overlay, the one it covers most of two, joining at the cursor brought onto it, on none while less than half covers either and with Alt held, and the hidden one is never a target.

Given two overlays, on the taskbar and in a corner, with the window open, when the window works out where each shows, then it is where each overlay's own window is, so the map's taskbar spot sits at the overlay's middle.
Given the built page in a real WebView2, when the window opens, then the keyboard's focus is in the page, so Ctrl+Z works without a click in it first.
Given a free overlay, when it is dropped on the taskbar near the mark beside the notification area, then it keeps no offset, so it follows the notification area as it grows.

Given the recorded CPU load series replayed as `thermi preview` replays it, on dark and on light pills, when the overlay is painted at 100 % and 150 %, then the CPU load's graph is 24 px wide at 100 % and draws each second it read as a line in the normal level's green over a light fill of it, never a block.

Given the admin recording's CPU temperature, 77 °C, warned by itself, when the overlay is painted at 100 % on the pills of a dark taskbar, and at 150 % past a warning line on the pills of a light one, then its bars are five segments 12 px wide at 100 %, the four lowest lit in its level's color and the top one a faint track, and the value at warning has no underline.
Given the RAM's load at 0, 3 and 50 % and reading nothing, when the overlay is laid out, then its meter lights 0, 1 and 3 of its five segments, and none while it reads nothing.

Given a table of overlays' Graph (Auto, None, Bars, Line), items' own (like the overlay, None, Bars, Line) and readings (a load, a temperature, the RAM in use warned by its load, a fan, power), each past its warning, when the overlay is laid out, then each item draws the row's None, Bars or Line, Auto a line for the load and bars for the rest, power nothing whatever is chosen, and only an item that draws nothing underlines its warning.

Given the version 5 file with every field, an item metered by its own duty's fan, a graph switched on, a combined item metered by one of its sensors, an item without a meter and the RAM metered by its load, when it is read, then it becomes version 6, the file of version 6 with every field but its first overlay's Graph and the window's theme, which version 6 brought, each item drawing and warning as it did.

Given Windows' apps light or dark and high contrast on or off, when the window's theme is Windows, Light or Dark, then the window is dark as chosen, as Windows' apps are for Windows, and as Windows' apps are under high contrast whatever was chosen; the file leaves Windows out.

Given the real window over Windows' dark mode, when Theme is set to Light, Dark and Windows in Settings, and the window is opened again in Light, then each applies at once to the page, the title row, the caption buttons and Mica, and the first frame of the window opened in Light is already light.

Given a series of CPU temperatures with a missing one and an overlay laid out as one bar with the GPU's load and the CPU's load before the CPU temperature, which shows its average, its minimum smoothed over 3 s, its value now smoothed over 5 s with an offset of -5, or its maximum reset midway, when the window's history takes the overlay's through the message after five seconds, having read one second already or none, and again after the reset, and both then read the rest, then each second the window's history lays the item out with the very value, label and tag the overlay's does, the tag after its value though the item is not the first of its pill, and no label carrying it.

Given the recorded CPU load series and an overlay laid out as one bar with the GPU's load before the CPU's load, which shows its average, when the overlay reads a third of the series before the real bridge opens and takes its history through the message, and both then read the rest, then each second the bridge's item shows the very value and label the overlay draws, never the bar's first label, and the tag the overlay draws after its value, which its label lacks.

Given the page with the fake bridge and the default overlay laid out as one bar, when the RAM's Shows is set to Average by keys, then its row in the list says the value the bridge gives followed by its tag, and its Label box offers the label the bridge says the overlay draws for it.

Given the default overlay on the taskbar, free on the desktop, at the monitor's left edge, vertical, and vertical near the work area's bottom, when "Separate" is chosen on its GPU pill, an overlay of its own as wide as a drag of it carries, wider out of one bar, then the pill becomes an overlay of its own 8 px before it on the taskbar or free, level with its middle, after it, below it, or above it.

Given a table of a menu's entries (words sharing first letters, letters of any case and language, an "&" of the text, none to take, a grayed note), when their access keys are marked, then each entry gets a key no entry above it took, from a word's start first, or none, a grayed note none, and an "&" of the text stays one.

Given a real overlay host on a test desktop with the default overlay, when its GPU pill is right-clicked and the access key of "Separate" is typed in the menu that opens, then the file holds the pill as an overlay of its own, and the menu's Undo puts it back as it was, in one step.

Given the installed build, the window open, and the overlay on the taskbar and on the desktop, in English and Spanish, light, dark and high contrast, when the author right-clicks a pill and the edge, and from an item's tray icon, and chooses each entry by mouse and by its key, then each changes what it says at once, the window shows it, its Undo in the menu and Ctrl+Z in the window take it back, and no entry offered does nothing.
Given the overlay page, when the theme is set to Light and then undone, then the preview at the top of Appearance shows the change and then its picture before it.

Given a recorded snapshot and an overlay in a light look with soft corners, its background at 60 % and bars, when the window previews it, then its picture is pixel for pixel the one "Copy as image" puts on the clipboard.

Given the installed build at 100 % and 150 %, when the overlay page is open on the taskbar overlay, then the preview and the look tiles look as the overlay does on screen, each edit shows within a second, and the idle window stays within R191's budget.

Given the CPU fan's page, its fan at about 1,100 RPM and no lines, when a warning line is added, moved by the arrows, dragged up while held and a press beside the knobs drags across the chart, then the line comes above the fan's speed and under one and a half times it, moves a step each way, its knob stays under the pointer while the range holds, and no text is selected.

Given a file joined by hand into one bar of GPU, CPU and RAM items, a CPU item starting its own pill, and the same file in the pills and each layouts, a GPU pill between two of the CPU's dragged off, and an overlay of the RAM merged after the RAM's pill, when the window lists the first overlay, then its pills are the runs the overlay labels in each layout, and the join or split keeps the pills that showed apart.

Given the default overlay in one bar with the admin recording's readings, at 100 % on dark pills and at 150 % on light ones, and vertical at 150 %, when it is painted, then the bar holds three pills, CPU, GPU and RAM, in the inner color, 4 px inside its edge and 4 px apart at 100 %, side by side or, vertical, stacked from top to bottom and as wide as the widest, and each item's pill is its run's.

Given the overlay's ten minutes of the RAM in use metered by its load and the window's seconds of it and of the CPU temperature showing its minimum, when Warn by turns off and the CPU temperature reads a DIMM, and both are undone, then each chart draws only the reading it draws now, what the window read of it before taken in, and the minimum is of that reading alone.

Given an overlay at 100 % and 200 % on a 48 px taskbar at 100 %, at 200 % on a 72 px taskbar at 150 %, and at 200 % free or vertical, when the size it shows at is worked out, then on a taskbar it is at most the taskbar's height, and elsewhere its own.
Given a host that painted the recording on its tick, when a warmer snapshot comes and no tick has come since, then the overlay already shows it, as the open window does.

Given a sensor pipe on the real clock and a client reading it, when the fan finder's own load, thermi cpu-load, spins every core for 8 s, then the load runs below normal priority and keeps the cores busy, and a snapshot still comes each second, never 2 s apart.

Given the CPU temperature item on Auto with a chart of the window's readings, when its Sensor is set to a cooler CCD for a few seconds and undone, then its chart holds only the seconds of the sensor Auto picks, none of the CCD's.
